papers.title_en: SpectrumQuant: Spectrum Alignment for LLM Quantization
papers.authors: Dwaipayan Haldar, Indranil Patra, Azhar Yousuf, Chandra Sekhar Seelamantula
papers.evidence: 用协方差感知正交旋转替代固定Hadamard变换以改善LLM量化
papers.tldr: 低比特量化中，正交变换可重塑激活分布，但现有方法要么依赖固定Hadamard旋转，要么需校准期学习旋转。SpectrumQuant从理论上证明最大化协方差可导向谱对齐，并据此提出闭式旋转构造：用校准数据估计激活协方差，生成协方差感知的正交变换用于训练后量化。该方法将量化友好的旋转分解为对齐与混合组件，并涵盖Hadamard特例。在Llama和Mistral上，其效果媲美先进旋转策略，GPU显存不足三分之一且耗时显著低于学习式方法。
papers.abstract_en: Orthogonal transforms have emerged as an effective tool for low-bit quantization of large language models (LLMs), as they reshape activation distributions without changing the underlying model function. Existing approaches typically rely either on fixed data-agnostic transforms, such as Hadamard rotations, or on calibration-time optimization of learned rotations. We study rotation selection from first principles and show that maximizing covariance leads to spectral alignment and provides a principled criterion for constructing quantization-friendly orthogonal transforms. Based on this insight, we propose SpectrumQuant, a closed-form rotation method that estimates activation covariance from calibration data and uses it to construct a covariance-aware orthogonal transform for post-training quantization. Our formulation characterizes quantization-friendly rotations as compositions of alignment and mixing components, while recovering Hadamard matrices as a special case. Interestingly, a class of butterfly matrices belongs to this category. In the realm of LLM quantization, SpectrumQuant bridges the gap between data-agnostic structured rotations and learned rotations, providing an effective and efficient data-aware alternative for post-training quantization. Experiments on Llama and Mistral models show that SpectrumQuant is competitive with state-of-the-art rotation strategies while requiring less than one-third of the GPU memory and significantly less time than learned rotations approaches like SpinQuant and DartQuant.

papers.title_en: STP-GUI: Spatially-Aware Token Pruning for Efficient Web-GUI Agents
papers.authors: Shuo Wang, Sifan Zhou, Xiaobo Wang, Tianyu Fu, Chenxu Zhao, Anyang Su, Hanning Wang, Ping Jiang, Minghui Wu
papers.evidence: 面向VLM智能体的视觉token剪枝
papers.tldr: Web-GUI 智能体依赖高分辨率截图与多轮历史，视觉 token 数量过多导致推理开销大；现有面向自然图像的剪枝方法按重要性独立选 token，容易打碎按钮、图标等小元素的局部结构。本文提出 STP-GUI，用查询引导的评分结合空间连贯的窗口级选择，在激进压缩下保留细粒度指令相关信息，并以策略学习优化轻量选择器、冻结 VLM 主干。在 Online-Mind2Web 上仅保留 21% token 仍达全量性能的 77.7%，延迟降 31%、FLOPs 降 57%，并在移动端 GUI 场景展现可迁移性。
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid development of vision-language models (VLMs), Web-GUI agents have achieved promising performance in interacting with real-world interfaces through screenshot-based grounding. However, high-resolution screenshots and multi-turn histories introduce excessive visual tokens, causing substantial inference overhead. Existing token pruning methods, mainly designed for natural images, often select tokens independently based on importance scores, which can fragment the local visual structures required for recognizing small GUI elements such as buttons, icons, and hyperlinks. In this work, we propose STP-GUI (Spatially-aware Token Pruning for GUI agents), a query-guided token pruning framework that preserves fine-grained instruction-conditioned token scoring while performing spatially coherent window-level selection under aggressive token reduction. A lightweight selector is optimized through policy learning while the VLM backbone remains frozen. Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets. At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%. Results on Android in the Wild further suggest that the method transfers to mobile GUI environments.

papers.title_en: CatchUp: Depth-Aware Re-Admission of Visual Tokens for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
papers.evidence: 面向高效大型视觉语言模型的视觉令牌剪枝与深度感知重准入
papers.tldr: 大型视觉语言模型逐层重复处理数百个视觉token，开销高；现有剪枝会不可逆丢弃低排名token，但高相关token集合随深度变化。CatchUp是免训练的深度感知重接纳框架：逐层重评查询相关token，仅计算被选中的token，保留暂缓token，并用语义与空间相关token的转移信号补全其表示演化。在定位与多模态基准上，CatchUp在64/128/192预算下平均相对保留率最高；64token预算下活跃视觉token减少88.9%，仍保留全模型92.17%平均性能，时延降低8.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) repeatedly process hundreds of visual tokens across decoder layers, incurring substantial computation and memory costs. Existing inference-time visual token pruning methods often irreversibly remove low-ranked tokens, although the set of visual tokens receiving high query-conditioned attention can change across decoder depth. Recoverable routing preserves skipped tokens for later reconsideration, but re-admits them with stale representations after bypassing intermediate transformations. We further find that replacing stale re-admitted states with their current-depth oracle states from a full-token reference trajectory substantially improves grounding performance. We therefore propose CatchUp, a training-free framework for depth-aware visual-token re-admission. CatchUp repeatedly re-evaluates query-conditioned visual relevance, processes only selected visual tokens through each decoder interval, and preserves deferred tokens for later re-admission. Upon re-admission, CatchUp approximates missed representation evolution using reference-to-current transition signals from semantically and spatially related visual tokens. Across three referring-expression grounding datasets and six multimodal benchmarks, CatchUp achieves the highest average relative retention in both benchmark groups at 64-, 128-, and 192-token budgets. At a 64-token budget with 88.9% fewer active visual tokens, CatchUp retains 92.17% of the full model's performance on average across six multimodal benchmarks while reducing end-to-end latency by 8.0%. Code is available at https://github.com/pej0918/CatchUp

papers.title_en: LIRQuant: An Efficient Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization Method for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Desheng Xu, Hanglin Li, Tianchen Song, Zhiyong Zhao, Kun Zhan
papers.evidence: 选择性旋转量化以缓解大语言模型激活离群值
papers.tldr: 大模型低比特后训练量化常受激活离群值困扰，现有全局旋转又忽略通道敏感度差异。LIRQuant提出敏感度感知的局部隔离旋转量化：用噪声加权指标筛选敏感通道，仅对其施加可学习旋转，其余通道用轻量固定旋转。该方法在LLaMA-2/3、Mistral、Qwen3和Mixtral的W4A4KV4设置取得领先精度，校准LLaMA-3-8B仅需25分钟、20.3GB峰值显存。融合核还实现最高2.3倍预填充加速和3.5倍显存节省，兼顾精度与部署效率。
papers.abstract_en: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet activation outliers remain a key challenge for low-bit quantization. Existing global transformation methods overlook heterogeneous channel sensitivity to quantization noise, leading to suboptimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose \textbf{Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization (LIRQuant)}, a sensitivity-aware framework that selectively applies transformations. LIRQuant identifies sensitive channels using a noise-weighted sensitivity metric, applying expressive learnable rotations only to these channels and lightweight fixed rotations to the remaining ones. This decoupled design reduces optimization complexity without sacrificing outlier smoothing capability. Extensive experiments across the LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Qwen3, and Mixtral families demonstrate that LIRQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under the challenging W4A4KV4 setting. Meanwhile, LIRQuant calibrates LLaMA-3-8B in only 25 minutes with 20.3 GB peak GPU memory, achieving the fastest calibration and the lowest memory footprint among recent learnable-rotation methods, and its fused inference kernels deliver up to $2.3\times$ prefill speedup and $3.5\times$ memory saving over FP16.

papers.title_en: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
papers.authors: Rhea Sanjay Sukthanker, Riccardo Grazzi, James Hensman, Pashmina Cameron
papers.evidence: 结合校准数据与恢复微调的大模型权重量化后训练
papers.tldr: 针对2比特训练后量化中标量PTQ精度跌至随机水平的问题，本文系统研究量化表示、校准数据与恢复微调数据三项数据相关选择。方法采用向量码本表示、任务对齐的小规模校准混合数据，以及低成本的仅码本恢复阶段。在3.8至32B的六类稠密与MoE模型上，该方案约2.3有效比特/权重，保留89%至97%全精度问答准确率，恢复后计算量比最强QAT基线少1.4至30倍。结果表明，低比特PTQ需联合设计表示与数据，向量码本和联合校准恢复可显著提升可用性。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with limited compute and data. Down to 4 bits it is near-lossless, but at 2 bits scalar PTQ configurations fall to chance-level accuracy. We study three choices usually treated as implementation details that matter little at 4 bits but decide 2-bit quality: the quantization representation, the calibration data, and the recovery fine-tuning data, across six dense and mixture-of experts models (ranging from $3.8$ to $32$B parameters). Representation is the largest factor and vector codebooks restore usable models where scalar PTQ pipelines collapse. Most of the remaining loss in accuracy is on \emph{generative} tasks, and the amount of performance drop is model-dependent. Furthermore, at a short recovery budget, calibration and recovery data are coupled. The best recovery data depends on the calibration data, so the two must be chosen jointly. The resulting recipe involves a vector codebook representation, a small task-aligned calibration mixture, and an inexpensive codebook-only recovery stage. Including codebooks, it uses about $2.3$ effective bits per weight and retains $89$ to $97\%$ of full-precision question-answering (QA) accuracy where scalar PTQ is at chance, and, including recovery, uses $1.4$ to $30\times$ less compute than the strongest quantization-aware-training (QAT) baseline.

papers.title_en: PACE: Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs
papers.authors: Lei Tian, Chunzheng Zhu, Kai Wu, Yifan Zhang, Haihua Yang
papers.evidence: 面向原生多模态大模型的token丢弃压缩流程与自适应token削减
papers.tldr: 原生多模态大模型直接切分像素块，视觉 token 冗余严重，而现有压缩方法面向 ViT-based 设置，未覆盖收益最大的 native MLLM。PACE 利用 Multimodal-RoPE 的维度解耦，将注意力分解为高、宽两个正交空间显著性估计，并以位置注意力门控得到方向感知重要性；同时把 token 预算分配建模为性能、效率与空间覆盖的 Pareto 优化，联合确定压缩深度和保留率。实验在仅保留 25%-50% 视觉 token 时保持近无损，部分基准提升，FLOPs 降低 2 倍以上。
papers.abstract_en: Native multimodal large language models (native MLLMs) jointly encode visual and linguistic sequences within a unified autoregressive Transformer, emerging as a promising paradigm for multimodal understanding. Unlike conventional ViT-based MLLMs relying on external vision encoders, ViT-free native MLLMs tokenize pixel patches directly, potentially suffering severe visual token redundancy. A pilot study confirms this: unlike ViT-based models that degrade under compression, ViT-free MLLMs tolerate aggressive compression with near-lossless or even improved performance. Yet existing compression methods target ViT-based settings, leaving native MLLMs, which stand to gain the most, unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce an analysis pipeline centered on token discriminability and cross-dimensional heterogeneous redundancy, revealing that (i) redundancy is distributed independently and heterogeneously along height and width axes, and (ii) early-layer visual tokens are indiscriminable and uniformly redundant. Guided by these findings, we propose PACE (Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs), the first visual token compression framework tailored for native MLLMs with Multimodal-RoPE. Leveraging dimensional decoupling of positional encoding, PACE decomposes attention into two orthogonal spatial saliency estimates along height and width, gated by a positional attention signal, yielding direction-aware importance with negligible overhead. It further casts token budget allocation as Pareto optimization over performance preservation, inference efficiency, and spatial coverage, jointly identifying optimal compression depths and retention ratios. Experiments show PACE maintains near-lossless performance at only 25%-50% visual token retention, even improving several benchmarks, while delivering over 2x FLOPs reduction.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical and Query-Aware Visual Token Pruning for High-Resolution LVLMs
papers.authors: Luther Wei, Ling Zou, Kang-Yang Huang, Yu-Syuan Xu, Wen-Huang Cheng
papers.evidence: 面向高分辨率LVLM的免训练分层查询感知视觉token剪枝
papers.tldr: 高分辨率LVLM需保留全局缩略图与局部裁剪，但数千视觉token使LLM推理代价高。本文提出免训练、查询感知的分层剪枝框架，在进入LLM前按样本复杂度、裁剪跨模态相似度和token级对齐分配预算并融合视觉显著性选token。在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，保留25%和10%视觉token时分别维持98.0%和94.8%性能，25%下推理吞吐提升2.0倍且POPE反超基线0.7分。该即插即用方法兼顾高分辨率细节与推理效率。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) preserve critical, fine-grained visual details by encoding a global thumbnail alongside multiple local crops. However, the resulting thousands of vision tokens introduce severe computational bottlenecks during Large Language Model (LLM) inference. Existing token pruning methods rely primarily on query-agnostic visual saliency, while current query-aware approaches either operate at a coarse crop-level resolution or compute token relevance too late, after vision tokens have already entered the heavy LLM layers. To address this, we propose a training-free, hierarchical token pruning framework that utilizes query guidance prior to executing any LLM blocks. Our top-down hierarchy first operates at the instance-level, dynamically scaling the vision token retention ratio of each sample based on its visual complexity. Next, at the crop-level, we distribute this sample budget across local crops using sentence-level cross-modal similarity. Finally, at the token-level, we exploit projected vision tokens alongside textual query token embeddings in the shared space to measure fine-grained alignment, applying a text-debiasing normalization to produce high-fidelity query scores. These query-guided budgets and scores are fused with local and global visual saliency metrics to select the most critical vision tokens. Extensive experiments on LLaVA-NeXT-7B demonstrate that our plug-and-play framework retains 98.0% and 94.8% of unpruned performance at 25% and 10% vision token retention, respectively. Notably, at 25% retention, our method delivers a 2.0x inference throughput speedup and even surpasses the unpruned baseline on POPE by 0.7 points.

papers.title_en: Are We Evaluating VLM Token Pruning Right? Looking Beyond Accuracy and Token Count
papers.authors: Geng Li, Guohao Chen, Shilin Shan, Jianfei Yang
papers.evidence: 超越准确率地评估VLM中的视觉token剪枝
papers.tldr: 现有视觉 token 剪枝评测依赖聚合准确率和保留 token 数，前者会掩盖关键 token 是否真被选中，后者无法反映真实端到端开销。作者提出 PAA-Bench 评测框架，并引入 Random-Pass@k 衡量随机剪枝下样本仍正确的频率，以界定 token 选择真正重要的难度层级；同时用 Preservation-Constrained Speedup（PCS）在统一保留目标下比较最大端到端加速。实验覆盖 8 种方法、3 个 VLM 主干与 9 个基准，发现更强的 token 压缩并不必然带来更大加速，方法差异在 token 选择关键样本上被放大，效率排名也随保留目标变化。
papers.abstract_en: Visual token pruning aims to reduce inference cost while preserving the capabilities of the original VLM. Yet existing evaluations rely on aggregate task accuracy and retained token count as proxies for pruning quality and actual efficiency. We reveal two limitations: 1) Aggregate accuracy can obscure whether a pruning method truly identifies critical visual tokens; many examples remain solvable under arbitrary token removal and models can exploit textual shortcuts when visual evidence is degraded. 2) Retained token count is an unreliable proxy for efficiency, as identical token budgets can incur different end-to-end costs depending on where and how pruning is performed. Consequently, comparisons based on aggregate accuracy and retained token counts fail to recover the global performance-efficiency Pareto frontier across methods. We introduce PAA-Bench, a plug-and-play evaluation framework for existing benchmarks, to evaluate whether pruning succeeds through meaningful token selection and whether this success translates into real speedup. To determine when token choice actually matters, we propose Random-Pass@k to measure how often an example remains correct under random pruning, enabling comprehensive evaluation across different levels of selection difficulty. To compare efficiency fairly, we introduce Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS) to report the maximum end-to-end speedup each method achieves under a shared preservation target. Experiments across 8 methods, 3 VLM backbones, and 9 benchmarks show that stronger token compression does not necessarily yield greater speedup, method differences widen on examples where token selection matters, and efficiency rankings change with the preservation target.

papers.title_en: Visual Sufficiency Landscapes: Understanding Query-Conditioned Reliability in Visual Token Pruning
papers.authors: Zhenghan Li, Kexin Sun, Wei Zheng, Peng Hu, Xiao Wei, Anbo Huang
papers.evidence: 分析视觉语言模型中视觉令牌剪枝的查询条件可靠性
papers.tldr: 视觉 token 剪枝常保留不同子集却维持相近性能，关键问题是成功子集数量如何随查询与预算变化。作者提出视觉充分性景观，用均匀采样子集中同时保持答案、参考答案似然和输出分布的比例度量充分性概率。在三个多模态模型上，该概率随输入与问题显著变化，并能提升全剪枝方法的失败预测与跨图像泛化。研究将成功子集丰度确立为可测量的局部可剪枝维度，并连接高风险剪枝条件识别。
papers.abstract_en: Different visual token pruning strategies retain different subsets while maintaining similar task performance. This motivates a combinatorial question: how many visual subsets can preserve model behavior, and how does their abundance depend on the query? We introduce visual sufficiency landscapes to characterize this abundance. At a fixed layer and budget, visual sufficiency probability is the fraction of uniformly sampled subsets that jointly preserve the dense model's answer, reference-answer likelihood, and output distribution. Independent sampling replicates separate input variation from estimation noise. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5-7B, differences between inputs on GQA and TextVQA exceed replication error, and different questions about the same GQA image produce distinct landscapes. Sufficiency probability also improves failure prediction for full pruning methods. On LLaVA, adding this probability increases AUC by 0.1151 for FastV, 0.0683 for VisionZip, and 0.1401 for SparseVLM, while reducing log loss and Brier score. Several architecture-adapted configurations on the other two models reproduce these gains. Under controlled selection rules, predictors trained on the original images reduce log loss on new images by 9.0%, 13.0%, and 14.1%, respectively. These results establish successful-subset abundance as a measurable dimension of local prunability and connect it to the identification of high-risk pruning conditions.

papers.title_en: ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Guangzong Si, Dong Wang, Yifan Yu, Miao Liu, Panwang Pan, Wentao Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向高效多模态大模型的视觉Token剪枝与回溯
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型将图像编码为密集视觉token，带来注意力与KV缓存开销；现有浅层剪枝把“暂停计算”与“永久删除”绑定，破坏模型推理模式。作者发现视觉回溯现象：中层会重新调用早前看似不重要的token。为此提出ReTrace，引入休眠token状态，在昂贵逐层计算外缓存非枢轴token，回溯窗口内恢复，信息吸收后再剪枝。在Qwen2.5-VL与InternVL3上FLOPs和KV缓存降低近90%，预填充加速2.83倍，复杂视觉语言基准性能保持良好。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encode images into dense visual token sequences, creating substantial attention and KV-cache overhead. Existing visual token compression methods reduce this cost by pruning low-saliency tokens in shallow layers, but this practice couples temporary computational deactivation with irreversible information deletion. We show that this coupling breaks an intrinsic inference pattern in MLLMs. Through layer-wise attention analysis, we identify \textbf{Visual Backtracking}: visual pivots remain spatially stable, yet in middle layers they actively retrieve context from tokens that appeared unimportant earlier. Thus, early low-saliency tokens can be inactive for computation while still being useful for later reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{ReTrace}, a backtracking-aware compression framework that introduces a dormant token state. ReTrace caches non-pivot tokens outside expensive layer-wise computation, restores them during the backtracking window, and prunes only after their information has been absorbed. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 demonstrate nearly 90\% reductions in FLOPs and KV cache, a 2.83$\times$ prefilling speedup, and strong performance retention across complex vision-language benchmarks.

papers.title_en: RoLaQ: Joint Rotation and Range Calibration for 2-Bit KV Caches in Multi-Head Latent Attention
papers.authors: Shiyu Ji, Peng Ling, Chen Lin, Shupeng Li, Yixuan Wang, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
papers.evidence: 学习旋转与量化范围联合校准以控制低比特量化误差
papers.tldr: 多头部潜在注意力将KV缓存压缩为每token共享潜变量，2比特量化下误差会同时干扰注意力匹配与值读取。RoLaQ是一种离线联合旋转与范围校准方法，在冻结键值投影定义的子空间内优化共享旋转，并耦合学习量化阈值与重建增益。在三个MLA模型、六个基准上，它在2比特方法中取得最高平均精度；DeepSeek-V2-Lite上实现3.96倍BF16 KV容量和2.51倍解码吞吐。该工作为长上下文MLA推理的低比特KV缓存提供了有效校准方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) compresses the content of a key-value cache into a shared latent per token, making low-bit storage attractive for long-context inference. At two bits, errors in this representation perturb both attention matching and value readout, with effects that depend on error direction and reconstruction scale. We introduce RoLaQ (Rotation-calibrated Latent Quantization), an offline method for joint rotation and range calibration. RoLaQ refines a shared rotation within subspaces defined by the frozen key and value projections, and jointly learns quantization ranges whose thresholds and reconstruction gains are coupled to control the shared signal's response. Prediction matching and attention-output supervision guide calibration with model weights frozen. Across three MLA models and six benchmarks, RoLaQ achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared 2-bit methods both without and with token protection. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite, an SGLang implementation provides 3.96 times the BF16 KV capacity under the same memory budget and 2.51 times its decode throughput with 256K input tokens.

papers.title_en: Fractional Power-of-Two Quantization for Efficient and Effective Multiplier-Free LLM Inference
papers.authors: Sunghyun Wee, Geunjae Choi, Hyeonjin Kim, Suyoung Kim, Nojun Kwak
papers.evidence: 面向无乘法器LLM推理的训练后幂二次权重量化
papers.tldr: LLM线性投影的MAC运算主导推理开销，低比特PTQ虽降成本，但PoT权重量化在低比特下因base-2网格过粗而精度明显下降。FPoT采用base-√2半八度分数PoT网格，结合均匀整数激活、校准期网格对齐及1-adder √2近似，保持全整数shift-add数据通路。在Llama-3-8B的4-bit权重/激活下，零样本常识推理较PoT基线相对提升8.72%，仅比均匀整数基线低0.4个百分点。该方案跨7个模型和3种比特宽验证，并可集成现有PTQ方法。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) demand efficient inference, where the multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations in linear projections dominate compute and energy cost. Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces this cost by mapping weights and activations to low-bit integers. Power-of-Two (PoT) weight quantization promises efficient multiplier-free LLM inference via shift-add logic, but suffers significant accuracy degradation at low bitwidths due to its coarse base-2 quantization grid. We introduce Fractional PoT (FPoT), a base-$\sqrt{2}$ (half-octave) fractional PoT grid that achieves practical 4-bit weight quantization while preserving a fully integer shift-add datapath. The method combines (i) the base-$\sqrt{2}$ weight grid with uniform integer activations, (ii) a calibration-time grid-alignment refinement absorbed into the static per-channel scale, and (iii) a lightweight 1-adder $\sqrt{2}$ approximation whose error is absorbed during weight calibration via approximate-grid quantization, yielding a processing element (PE) with significantly fewer gates than a 4-bit integer multiplier. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weight and activation quantization, FPoT improves zero-shot commonsense reasoning performance by 8.72% relative to the PoT baseline, while maintaining performance close to the uniform integer baseline, with only a negligible 0.4%p degradation. These results hold across various configurations spanning seven models and three bit-widths. Furthermore, FPoT can be integrated with state-of-the-art LLM PTQ methods, demonstrating framework-agnostic applicability.

papers.title_en: RoleQ: Role-Aligned Scales for Converting Language Models to Ternary
papers.authors: Johannes Knittel, Alec Helbling, Hanspeter Pfister
papers.evidence: 面向大语言模型的低于四比特三值权重量化与角色对齐尺度
papers.tldr: 低于4比特量化虽压缩内存与带宽，却常牺牲事实知识与任务准确率，三元权重又多依赖从头训练或长时间微调。RoleQ按Transformer单元的功能角色而非权重矩阵布局放置尺度：读取残差流的向量每个输出单元一个尺度，写入残差流的向量每个输入单元一个尺度，无需搜索、校准或存储状态。在0.6B至14B各规模上，三元量化的困惑度比按布局放置尺度最多降低一半；每个权重1.59比特，仅需数GPU小时，并在困惑度、零样本与MMLU上领先同类后训练三元方法。
papers.abstract_en: Weight quantization below four bits shrinks memory and bandwidth at a perplexity that looks acceptable, but often at the cost of factual knowledge and task accuracy. Ternary weights have mostly been obtained by training from scratch or long fine-tuning. We introduce RoleQ, a quantization framework that places scales by the functional roles of Transformer units rather than by the layout of the weight matrix, as conventional formats do. Vectors that read from the residual stream take one scale per output unit; those that write to it, one per input unit. The rule is structural, needs no search, calibration or stored state, and holds on integer and ternary grids. In a rotated basis it matches a per-layer axis search at half the solver work, and at ternary it cuts perplexity by up to half against layout-based placement in two families at every size from 0.6B to 14B, where per-row scales leave MMLU at chance. Our lightweight post-training pipeline converts an existing checkpoint to 1.59 bits per weight in a few GPU-hours, a fraction of the cost of learned ternarization, and leads every post-training ternary method at matched or lower memory-resident bits on perplexity, zero-shot accuracy and MMLU, most widely on knowledge. A sparse second ternary plane placed by a per-unit Fisher saliency keeps the matmul multiplication-free and recovers what ternary loses first: at 8B, a fraction of a bit returns about half the MMLU that conversion costs, well ahead of random or Hessian-based placement at equal bits.

papers.title_en: FastVLA: Task-Conditioned and Temporally Adaptive Visual Token Compression for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Jiuyi Xu, Chengyuan Qian, Zhengzhong Tu, Yang Sui, Yangming Shi
papers.evidence: 面向VLA模型的任务感知时间自适应视觉token压缩
papers.tldr: VLA模型闭环部署受高分辨率多视角视觉token计算与延迟制约，通用显著性压缩难以保留任务关键信息且固定预算不适应逐步变化。FastVLA提出免训练、任务感知且时序自适应的视觉token压缩：用任务到视觉注意力打分，并以逆Simpson指标在线滑窗校准压缩率。在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT及LIBERO、SIMPLER和真实Franka上，降低LLM FLOPs 35-59%、动作延迟9-32%，真实机器人提速25%且成功率相当。它为VLA提供即插即用、效率与性能兼顾的压缩方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models present a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation, but closed-loop deployment is often limited by inference efficiency: at each timestep, high-resolution, often multi-view images are encoded into hundreds of visual tokens that dominate transformer computation and latency. Token compression via attention is a natural solution but is challenging for VLA control because (1) decision-critical tokens are determined by the task, not generic visual saliency, and (2) the token budget varies substantially across steps, so static metrics and budgets waste computation or discard control-critical tokens. We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration. We evaluate FastVLA on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and CogACT across LIBERO and SIMPLER, and on a physical Franka Research 3 robot. In simulation, it reduces LLM-backbone FLOPs by 35-59\% and action latency by 9-32\% (a 1.09$\times$-1.46$\times$ speedup) while maintaining task success, achieving a comparable or better efficiency-performance trade-off than existing plug-and-play token compression/pruning/reuse baselines. On the real robot, it cuts action-prediction latency by 20\% (1.25$\times$ speedup) at comparable success. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/FastVLA.

papers.title_en: PN-Mix: Pair-Norm Guided Mixed-Precision Key Cache Quantization for Efficient Long-Output LLM Inference
papers.evidence: 面向LLM推理的混合精度KV缓存量化
papers.tldr: 长输出LLM推理受KV cache显存与带宽瓶颈制约，低比特量化尤其2-bit会显著损害精度。PN-Mix从RoPE通道对的query-key pair-norm乘积出发，识别对attention logit扰动大的通道对，并在prefill阶段一次性分配更高精度、解码阶段复用。2.26-bit平均精度下，其在推理、代码生成和AIME基准上平均准确率不逊于2.32–2.39-bit方法，且低至1.5-bit仍较平滑退化，为长输出推理提供更优混合精度key cache量化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Long-output inference in large language models suffers from severe KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. While KV cache quantization alleviates this issue, low-bit quantization (e.g., 2-bit) severely degrades model accuracy. Recent mixed-precision key-cache quantization methods mitigate this degradation by allocating higher precision to important key channels, but estimate channel saliency using only key statistics. Through attention logit perturbation analysis at the RoPE channel-pair level, we show that quantization errors in channel pairs with large query--key pair-norm products contribute significantly to logit variation. Based on this insight, we propose PN-Mix, a mixed-precision key-cache quantization method for RoPE-based decoder-only LLMs, which allocates higher precision to salient channel pairs identified once during the prefill stage and reused throughout decoding. Across standard reasoning, code-generation, and AIME benchmarks, PN-Mix with 2.26-bit average precision achieves comparable or better average accuracy than prior mixed-precision methods using 2.32--2.39 bits. Furthermore, in our Pareto sweep, PN-Mix degrades gracefully down to 1.5 bits, whereas the compared baselines exhibit sharper performance drops below 2.25 bits.

papers.title_en: Complementary Future Token Pruning for World Action Models
papers.authors: Baekseung Kim, Junhoo Lee, Sohyeon Hong, Suhyun Jeon, Minkyu Kim, Seungyeon Kim, Donghoon Han, Nojun Kwak
papers.evidence: 在世界动作模型中剪枝密集未来帧视频token
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型需处理稠密未来帧token，推理延迟高。CF-Prune作为免训练剪枝框架，利用指令与动作注意力在首轮去噪中定位任务相关token，并用熵识别精度阶段以保留密集计算。在35%和50%剪枝率下取得1.19-1.33倍加速，成功率不降甚至提升，为预训练WAMs提供高效推理方案。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict future visual states and robot actions, but processing dense future-frame tokens incurs substantial inference latency. We propose CF-Prune, a training-free framework for pruning future-frame tokens in pretrained WAMs. Our key insight is that future visual predictions support action generation and therefore need not preserve every visual detail required for high-fidelity video synthesis. CF-Prune combines instruction and action attention to identify task-relevant tokens during the initial denoising forward pass, even when future-frame and action representations remain highly noisy. An entropy-based phase identification mechanism further retains dense computation during precision phases to mitigate pruning-induced performance degradation. Experiments on RoboLab, RoboCasa, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate consistent inference speedups. At a 35% pruning ratio, CF-Prune achieves average speedups of 1.19-1.27x while improving task success rates. At a 50% pruning ratio, it achieves 1.29-1.33x average speedups on both simulation benchmarks, with overall success rates within 1.0 percentage point of the baseline.

papers.title_en: Beyond Expert Rankings: Contrast Calibration for Mixed-Precision MoE Quantization
papers.authors: Renjie Xie, Juncheng Yang, Aoting Hu, Yan Liang, Mingxi Zhang, Zheheng Hong, Wei Xu, Yanzhi Chen
papers.evidence: 面向混合专家语言模型的混合精度训练后量化分配
papers.tldr: MoE 模型每 token 仅激活少量专家却需存储全部权重，混合精度量化可按敏感度分配位宽，但仅凭专家排名难以确定误差权重。本文提出 NatScale，用模型特定幂变换将梯度专家权重校准到信息论对比目标，并联合评估 gate、up、down 配置估计输出误差。在三种模型九个设置中，NatScale 对五种分配基线均取得最低 native-to-quantized KL 和最高 top-token 一致率，七项困惑度最低。结果表明面向目标的精度分配比单纯排名更关键。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models activate only a few experts per token, yet all expert weights must be stored. Mixed-precision quantization reduces this storage cost by assigning higher bit-widths to sensitive experts and lower bit-widths to resilient ones, but expert rankings alone do not determine how strongly to weight their errors. To address this gap, we propose NatScale, a contrast-calibrated allocation framework for mixed-precision MoE quantization. It uses a model-specific power transformation to calibrate gradient-based expert weights to an information-theoretic contrast target while preserving rankings. We jointly evaluate each expert's gate, up and down configurations to estimate its output error. We then combine these errors and calibrated weights with an existing prior based on weight spectra, variance and precision decay to select configurations under a storage budget. Across three models, NatScale achieves the lowest native-to-quantized KL divergence and the highest top-token agreement in all nine settings against five allocation baselines. It also yields the lowest perplexity in seven settings. These findings highlight the importance of objective-aware precision allocation.
